title: Query Cancellation
description: Learn how to cancel queries when they're no longer needed.

data.text: React Query supports **query cancellation** using AbortController. This is useful for canceling requests when components unmount or when a new request supersedes the old one.

data.title: AbortController
Automatic Cancellation
data.text: React Query automatically cancels queries when they're no longer needed. Just pass the signal to your fetch call.
